english.note: Use this for the comfortable, sheltered bubble that keeps someone from facing unfamiliar people, ideas, or experiences.

examples.english: You have to step out of your comfort bubble before you will dare try new things.
examples.traditional: 你要行出舒適圈，先至敢試新嘢。
